changelog: Follows Jellyfin interface language using native translations and live updates. Localizes common labels, counts, accessibility and menu matching; adds action icons with translated tooltips. CoverFlow-specific messages have Italian/English fallbacks.
description: Adds an accessible CoverFlow browser to Jellyfin Web for existing media libraries. It uses Jellyfin metadata and images without modifying library data.
name: CoverFlow
overview: Browse Jellyfin libraries with a 3D CoverFlow interface.
